title: Symmetries of Counterfactuals: Identification and Testability of Counterfactual Maps from Covariate Heterogeneity
abstract: arXiv:2611.22948v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In general, counterfactuals are not identified from data alone, because many causal models produce the same observed distributions but different counterfactuals. A common approach to circumvent this problem is to restrict the mechanism to a class in which it becomes unique, such as triangular monotone maps or optimal transport maps. However, whether the assumed class is correct is usually not examined. In this work, we study what the data can tell us when covariates are available that influence the outcome only through its latent cause. First, we characterise all counterfactual maps that are consistent with the data. They differ from the true map by a group of symmetries that preserve the conditional outcome distributions given the covariates. The more these distributions vary across covariate values, the smaller the group. Second, we show that for the classes above, consistency with the data is equivalent to a single conditional indep

translated_title: 反事实的对称性：从协变量异质性出发研究反事实映射的可识别性与可检验性
translated_abstract: 一般而言，反事实无法仅凭数据得到识别，因为许多因果模型会产生相同的观测分布，却对应不同的反事实。规避这一问题的常见做法是将机制限制在使其唯一确定的类别中，例如三角单调映射或最优传输映射。然而，所假设的类别是否正确通常并未得到检验。在本工作中，我们研究了当存在仅通过潜在原因影响结果的协变量时，数据能够告诉我们什么。首先，我们刻画了所有与数据一致的反事实映射：它们与真实映射的差异仅在于一组保持“给定协变量条件下结果分布”不变的对称性；这些条件分布在协变量取值之间变化越大，该对称群就越小。其次，我们证明，对于上述类别，与数据的一致性等价于一个单一的条件独立性命题（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文刻画了与观测数据一致的所有反事实映射——它们彼此仅相差一个由协变量条件结果分布决定的对称群（协变量异质性越强，对称群越小），并证明对于三角单调映射和最优传输映射等常见反事实类别，与数据的一致性可归结为一个可检验的条件独立性命题。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes all data-consistent counterfactual maps as differing from the true map only by symmetry groups preserving conditional outcome distributions given covariates (shrinking with stronger covariate heterogeneity), and shows that for common classes such as triangular monotone and optimal transport maps, consistency with data reduces to a single testable conditional independence statement.
